_comment: Copy this file to apify_config.json (gitignored) and confirm/adjust before use. The actor IDs and input fields below are BEST-EFFORT, UNVERIFIED research (reconstructed from search-engine snippets, not the live Apify Input schema — no session available to us could actually load apify.com's pages). Open each actor's page in the Apify Console and check its 'Input' tab before running; fix field names here if they differ.
_facebook_actor_notes: Official Apify actor. Discovery is via a Facebook Ad Library *search URL* you build yourself (not a plain keyword field) — see https://www.facebook.com/ads/library/?active_status=active&ad_type=all&country=ALL&q=KEYWORD&search_type=keyword_unordered, swap KEYWORD/country. Pay-per-result, roughly $3.40-5.80 per 1,000 ads depending on plan. Alternative with a richer schema (EU transparency/reach data): memo23/facebook-ads-library-scraper-cheerio ($31/mo rental + usage).
_google_actor_notes: Supports keyword-based discovery (not just known advertiser IDs), mixing keywords/advertiserIds/domains in one run. Pay-per-event, roughly $0.80 per 1,000 ads. Alternative (URL-driven, hits Google's internal RPC directly, no browser): memo23/google-ad-transparency-scraper-cheerio (~$1.20/1,000 ads).
